slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉

“倒是会挑地方。”
李寒山走出院子，不由眼睛一亮。
只见远处山峦叠嶂，云雾缭绕，隐约可见雕梁画栋的亭台楼阁掩映其间。偶尔有几道遁光掠过天际，想来是合欢宗的弟子在御空飞行。
合欢宗所在之地，不仅美如人间仙境，灵气更是充沛无比。
他如今已踏入炼气期，对灵气的感知愈发敏锐，只觉得呼吸之间，便有丝丝灵气沁入肺腑。
花弄影这院子周边风光极美，四处开满鲜花，背倚竹林，一侧还有瀑布飞流而下。但周围看不到其它的建筑，想来内门弟子不是太多，居住得比较松散。
李寒山不准备走太远，也不准备在合欢宗乱逛。这一次反杀花弄影着实凶险，万一被其它妖女抓去，他不敢保证自己还能完成反杀。
他来到一块石头后方，将衣服撩起，朝肚子看去，看了一会儿后，李寒山又伸手布满老茧的手，细细摩挲起来。
“什么都没有，难道是我眼花了？”李寒山蹙起眉头。
但在与花弄影行事的过程中，李寒山恍惚看到他的小腹上有一道若隐若现的神秘纹路。不止是他，花弄影的小腹上，同样存在着类似的纹路。
“对了，阳册。”
李寒山将阳册功法运转，这一运转，他的小腹处，一个似花非花的淡金色纹路浮现了出来。
见状，虽然还不知道这纹路有什么用，李寒山却是松了一口气。
“看来是阳册功法带来的。”
他最怕的是，这个纹路是花弄影弄出来的，那肯定对他不利。若是阳册功法带来的，那不利的一方，便是花弄影了。
李寒山将衣服放下，没再过多探究，他望着远方，盘算起来。
“那妖女脸变得太快了，她的修为应该是炼气后期，离筑基不远......”
虽然有心魔誓约在，他总觉得不够稳妥。在离开的时候，花弄影那川剧般的变脸速度，事实上被他察觉到了。
对方如此隐忍，肯定有什么后手。

花弄影至少是炼气后期，说不定能找到办法绕开心魔誓约，就算绕不开，她想要弄死李寒山太容易了。。
比如稍稍向别人暗示一下，李寒山能反采补，就足够让他死无葬身之地。
这里可是合欢宗！
他身具的功法，可以说是合欢宗修士的克星，一旦曝光，他的下场不难想象。
“关键还是实力啊。”李寒山叹了一口气。
他现在刚刚炼气，连战斗的术法也不会，实力太过寒碜了一点。想到这里，李寒山站了起来，准备回去修炼一番。
花弄影的院子结构很简单，正中一个大房间，两侧一边是婢女起居的地方，另一边是厨房之类的功能房间，她的里间，自然就位于大房间的深处，紧挨着崖壁。
这个最大的房间，现在属于李寒山了，他占着这里，也能知晓花弄影的动向。
“太慢了。”
小半天后，李寒山放弃了自行修炼，与通过阳册修炼比起来，自己埋头苦修着实太慢了一点。
于是在休养了一晚后，他再度闯入里间。
“妖女，该修行了！”
“主人.....不要这么粗鲁嘛......”
里间，顿时春光烂漫。
......
“我这百年老腰哎.....”
一顿修炼下来，李寒山的修为又有了精进，身体却有些吃不消了。
他这身子骨经过半个月的药浴已然强了许多，但底子终究是百年残躯，哪里经得起连番征伐。
“主人，奴家来帮你揉揉。”
花弄影纤指上闪现灵光，动用了一门术法为李寒山揉起了腰杆，目光温柔得像是在看三世情人一般。

可事实上，她的眼底却闪过一丝痛快：“让你欺负老娘，活该！”
李寒山舒舒服服的趴在床上，享受着美人按摩的同时，给她布置起了任务：“你那药汤再为我调配一些，我得先把身体补起来。”
“是...”花弄影心里来了一顿含妈量极高的吐嘈后，换上了为难的表情：“只是，那药汤很贵的，里面的每种灵药都价值不菲，以奴家现在所剩的灵石，恐怕支撑不了多久。”

"I know how to choose a place."
When Li Hanshan walked out of the yard, his eyes lit up.
I saw mountains in the distance, shrouded in clouds and mist, and vaguely carved pavilions and pavilions hidden among them. Occasionally, there are a few rays of light passing through the sky. It seems that they are disciples of the Hehuan Sect flying in the sky.
The place where Hehuan Sect is located is not only as beautiful as a fairyland on earth, but is also extremely rich in aura.
Now that he has entered the Qi refining stage, his perception of spiritual energy has become more and more acute. He can only feel that there is a trace of spiritual energy entering his lungs between his breaths.
The scenery around the courtyard of Huarongying is extremely beautiful, with flowers blooming everywhere, a bamboo forest at its back, and a waterfall flowing down one side. But there are no other buildings around, so I guess there aren't too many inner disciples and they live relatively loosely.
Li Hanshan was not prepared to go too far, nor was he prepared to wander around the Hehuan Sect. The counter-killing of Hua Nongying this time was really dangerous. If he was caught by other demon girls, he couldn't guarantee that he would be able to complete the counter-killing.
He came behind a stone, lifted up his clothes, and looked at his stomach. After looking at it for a while, Li Hanshan stretched out his calloused hand and rubbed it carefully.
"There's nothing. Could it be that I'm dazzled?" Li Hanshan frowned.
But while acting with Hua Nongying, Li Hanshan vaguely saw a mysterious line on his lower abdomen. Not only him, Hua Nongying also had similar lines on his lower abdomen.
"By the way, Yang Ce."
Li Hanshan operated the Yang Ce Kung Fu. With this operation, a pale golden pattern that looked like a flower but not a flower appeared on his lower abdomen.
Seeing this, Li Hanshan breathed a sigh of relief, although he still didn't know what the lines were for.
"It seems that it was brought about by Yang Ce Kung Fu."
What he was most afraid of was that the lines were caused by Hua Nongying, which would definitely be detrimental to him. If it was caused by the Yang Ce technique, the disadvantaged party would be Hua Nongying.
Li Hanshan put down his clothes and didn't explore further. He looked into the distance and made calculations.
"That witch's face changed too quickly. Her cultivation should be in the late stage of Qi refining, not far from foundation building..."
Even though he had the inner demon's oath, he always felt that it wasn't safe enough. When leaving, Hua Nongying's face-changing speed was actually noticed by him.
The other party must be so forbearing, there must be some back-up plan.
Hua Nongying was at least in the late stage of Qi refining, so she might be able to find a way to circumvent the Heart Demon Oath. Even if she couldn't circumvent it, it would be too easy for her to kill Li Hanshan. .
For example, a slight hint to others that Li Hanshan could take supplements would be enough to make him die without a burial place.
This is the Hehuan Sect!
The skills he possesses can be said to be the nemesis of Hehuan Sect monks. Once exposed, his fate is not difficult to imagine.
"The key is strength." Li Hanshan sighed.
He has just refined his Qi and doesn't even know how to fight. His strength is too meager. Thinking of this, Li Hanshan stood up and prepared to go back to practice.
The structure of Hua Nongying's courtyard is very simple. There is a large room in the middle, with the maid's living quarters on one side and functional rooms such as the kitchen on the other side. Her inner room is naturally located deep in the large room, close to the cliff.
This largest room now belongs to Li Hanshan. He occupies this room and can know Hua Nongying's movements.
"Too slow."
After half a day, Li Hanshan gave up practicing on his own. Compared with practicing through Yang Book, practicing hard on his own was really too slow.
So after a night of rest, he broke into the inner room again.
"Witch, it's time to practice!"
"Master... don't be so rude..."
Inside, spring suddenly bloomed.
...
"I'm a century old..."
After a meal of practice, Li Hanshan's cultivation improved again, but his body was a little overwhelmed.
His body has become much stronger after half a month of medicinal bathing, but after all, it is still a broken body that has lasted for a hundred years. How can it withstand repeated attacks?Conquest.
"Master, I'll help you rub it."
There was a flash of light on Hua Nong Ying's fingers, and she used a magic technique to rub Li Hanshan's waist, her eyes were as gentle as if she were looking at a lover for three generations.
But in fact, a trace of joy flashed in her eyes: "You deserve to bully me!"
Li Hanshan lay comfortably on the bed and while enjoying the beauty's massage, he assigned her a task: "Make some more of your medicinal soup for me. I have to replenish my body first."
"Yes..." Hua Nongying made a very pregnant rant in her heart, then put on a troubled expression: "It's just that the medicinal soup is very expensive, and every elixir in it is valuable. The remaining spiritual stones of the Yinu family may not be able to sustain it for long."
